raw_meta_yaml:
schema_version: 1

context:
  name: markdown-customblocks
  version: 1.5.4

package:
  name: ${{ name|lower }}
  version: ${{ version }}

source:
  url: https://pypi.org/packages/source/${{ name[0] }}/${{ name }}/${{ name | replace('-', '_') }}-${{ version }}.tar.gz
  sha256: 830cc1e11dc662aae21589e336c52da7db07878df3e250f21d5d221fa68e5f2b

build:
  number: 0
  noarch: python
  script: ${{ PYTHON }} -m pip install . -vv

requirements:
  host:
    - pip
    - python ${{ python_min }}.*
    - setuptools >=75
    - wheel
  run:
    - python >=${{ python_min }}
    - markdown
    - yamlns >=0.11
    - beautifulsoup4
    - decorator
    - geocoder
    - pytest
    - pytest-cov <4
    - responses
    - python-magic
    - pillow

tests:
  - python:
      imports:
        - customblocks
      pip_check: true
      python_version: ${{ python_min }}.*

about:
  summary: Python Markdown extension to add custom parametrizable and nestable blocks
  license: AGPL-3.0-only
  license_file: LICENSE
  homepage: https://github.com/vokimon/markdown-customblocks

extra:
  recipe-maintainers:
    - thewchan
